{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of customer_age
print("Distribution of customer_age:")
print(sales['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check how many -1 values there are
print(f"\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age: {(sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check for any other invalid values
print(f"\nUnique values in customer_age: {sorted(sales['customer_age'].unique())}")"}
